title: Microsoft Teams: Workflows trigger "A form is submitted" collects answers in a SharePoint list
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents the equivalent SharePoint form-submission trigger and its Standard connector classification, so the briefing overstates what is unknown about licensing and connector governance. The data-policy role guidance omits the Dataverse qualification, and the claim that no submission-started workflow report is documented overlooks cloud-flow run history.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft documentation does not establish which connector or connector class the equivalent list-form trigger belongs to.
claims.quote: # SharePoint ... | Power Automate | Standard | All Power Automate regions | ... When a form is submitted (preview) ... Operation ID: GetOnNewItemsFromForm
claims.fix: Replace the connector-identity and class uncertainty with: 'The SharePoint connector reference documents the equivalent When a form is submitted (preview) trigger, operation GetOnNewItemsFromForm, and classifies the connector as Standard for Power Automate. SharePoint is not blockable, and connector action control does not support unblockable connectors. MC1466757 nevertheless says existing DLP policies that block the trigger continue to apply; the notice and connector-control documentation do not explain that difference.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/connectors/sharepointonline/ alongside the existing connector-action-control and prevent-data-loss sources. Remove the open question asking which connector or Standard/Premium class it uses.
